detailed_descriptions_html.en:
A fan-favorite heister known for his iconic chicken mask, voice recorder, and taste for ruthless violence, Jacket is back!

Jacket appeared at the Gang's hideout without warning or explanation. While he didn’t bother to say where he had been, a sharp observer could follow a trail of brutalized bodies leading up the East Coast, ending in New York City.

The Jacket Character Pack includes:

  • ‘Jacket’ playable character with signature outfit

  • ‘Richard Rising’ signature mask

  • ‘Miami Decadence’ preset weapon

  • ‘Sociopath’ Overskill weapon

  • ‘Letterman’ charm

  • ‘Richard 1989’ sticker
